overallReasoning.summary: One isolated, single-region staging environment preserves the approved release profile. Private data and SCM use explicit network paths; the public web is exposed only through a filtered Standard Front Door origin. Background processing is paused.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: This is a paid staging proposal, not production-ready infrastructure. Explicit approval is needed for Key Vault-managed Prisma/Entra credentials, Premium Files shared-key content storage and public authenticated monitoring. No-Files Functions, passwordless Prisma and AMPLS are alternatives requiring different implementation/cost validation. Production DNS, live email, Defender/Event Grid activation, legal/accessibility acceptance, recovery and real tenant acceptance remain out of scope for initial provisioning.

architecturePrinciples: Reference existing resources without modifying or recreating them.
Private data connectivity and least privilege; no broad public database exception.
Separate application, worker and privileged release identities.
Immutable application artifacts and separately authorized database changes.
No live background activity or production cutover through code deployment alone.
Disclose security exceptions, incomplete verification and usage-based costs.
